For a 50-person Indian company, the purchase-ready shortlist is:

Option	Cost structure	Key trade-off	Verify before signing
FCM Travel India	Custom TMC/transaction fee + actual travel spend	More hands-on management and 24/7 support; potentially higher service fees	Per-ticket fee, hotel mark-up, after-hours fee, refund handling, SLA, minimum annual spend
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Custom service fee + travel spend; payment fees may apply	Simpler/self-service, potentially lower management overhead, but less bespoke support	Exact booking/service fee, payment fee, cancellation/refund treatment, dedicated account manager, credit terms
Amex GBT	Custom TMC fee + travel spend	Strong central billing/reporting and global programme capabilities; potentially more enterprise-oriented	India transaction fee, implementation cost, minimum volume, support SLA, billing/credit terms

For FCM specifically, its current India offering includes 24/7 emergency assistance, policy advice, payment solutions and traveller-safety services. Its hotel programme advertises negotiated rates and savings of up to 38%, but that is not a guaranteed saving for your company.

Purchase checklist

Before paying, require a written 12-month all-in quote showing:

Every booking/amendment/cancellation fee

GST and payment charges

Hotel/airline mark-ups

Refund timeline

24/7 support SLA

Implementation/setup fee

Minimum-spend or lock-in clause

Exit/termination terms

For a 50-person company, I would run the same 20 representative trips through all three quotes and compare final payable amounts rather than comparing advertised discounts.
